home.why: Hero is text: LCP follows the head bytes (about 8-9 ms per raw KB in the lab); the home is the heaviest first screen.

me.why: Recruiter page: hero photo plus experience blocks; its LCP margin is the thinnest after /experiments/.

experiments.why: Two featured pieces; the CSS of compact cards, pager, sort switch and gallery ships only where it renders.

changelog.why: Release days grouped by kind, 4 days per page (page 1 opens the 2 newest); the flat list was about 130 KB, and the page CSS ships only here.

contact.why: Form page: the lightest shared head, only the site stylesheet plus the form.

subscribe.why: Form page: the site stylesheet plus a small form, no page-specific CSS to speak of.

notes-index.why: Listing of note cards: site stylesheet only. Every category and tag is a link to the filtered index, which costs about 4 KB of HTML.

note.why: Note pages: article typography, share card and footprint button; the note-page LCP gate moves with a few hundred bytes (docs/TESTING.md).

default.why: Legal pages, subscribe steps, paged or sorted listings: ceiling for anything without its own type.
